lines: Frame Material: M40X + 40 Tonne Nano Science

• FSC Wing Knife Design is developed to support frame stability and control
• M40X and 40 Tonne Nano Science materials
• Medium flexibility provides a balanced playing feel
• 3U and 4U weight options to suit different handling preferences
• Designed for fast racket movement, stable handling and versatile court play
